meta.title: How to better work towards long-term goals

paragraphs.text: Hal Hershfield, a psychologist at the UCLA Anderson School of Management, wanted to know why people weren't saving for retirement. Across the board, people are living longer. Logically, they'll need more money to live comfortably in their post-work years. And yet, savings rates in the U.S. have gone down in recent decades, not up.

paragraphs.text: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits (特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other. As participants answered, Hershfield's team recorded which parts of their brains lit up. Unsurprisingly, people's brains were most active when thinking about their current selves and least active when thinking about a current other. But the team found that participants' brain activity while considering their future selves more closely resembled their brain activity while thinking about a current other rather than the current self.

sentences.text: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits (特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other.

analysis.translationLiteral: 为了帮助解释这一看似不理性的行为，赫什菲尔德和他的团队扫描了研究参与者的大脑，同时问他们各种特征——如「可敬的」或「风趣的」——在多大程度上适用于当下的自己、未来的自己、当下的他人或未来的他人。
analysis.translationNatural: 为解释这种看似不理性的做法，团队给受试者做脑扫描，同时让他们判断「可敬」「风趣」这类特质在多大程度上符合现在的我、未来的我、现在的别人、未来的别人。
analysis.structMarkup: (To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior), 【Hershfield and his team】 _scanned_ ~the brains of study participants~ (while asking them to what degree various traits (特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 不定式目的状语 + while 引导的时间状语（内含宾语从句）

components.note: 并列主语，谓语用过去式 scanned

components.part: while asking them to what degree various traits (特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other

句中含让步/对比连词，引导状语从句；主句不再用 but 呼应。

phrases.meaning: 帮助（help sb do sth / help with）；帮助（不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：help sb do/to do（不带 doing）/ can't help doing（忍不住）。常见搭配：help sb do sth / help with。
phrases.example: Instincts can help you decide fast. 直觉能帮你快速决定。

phrases.meaning: 解释、说明、阐明；为…辩解
phrases.usage: 注意区分：explain sth to sb（向某人解释，介词 to）/ explain that / explain why（解释…）/ explain 与 interpret（口译；解读）/ explanation（名词）/ explain 与 complain（抱怨，拼写易混）。
phrases.example: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits (特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other. 为解释这种看似不理性的做法，团队给受试者做脑扫描，同时让他们判断「可敬」「风趣」这类特质在多大程度上符合现在的我、未来的我、现在的别人、未来的别人。

phrases.meaning: 不理性的、不合理的、荒谬的（本文指非理性行为）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：irrational（不理性的、失去理智的）/ rational（理性的，反义）/ ir- 是 in- 在 r 前的同化（il-/im-/ir- 都是 in- 变体）/ irrational 与 unreasonable（不讲道理、要求过分）。
phrases.example: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits (特征)—like "honorable" or "funny"—applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other. 为解释这种看似不理性的做法，团队给受试者做脑扫描，同时让他们判断「可敬」「风趣」这类特质在多大程度上符合现在的我、未来的我、现在的别人、未来的别人。

phrases.meaning: 记录、记载、登记；录制、录音（过去式）；有记录的、创纪录的

pitfalls: 注意区分：answered（过去式/过去分词）/ answer（原形）。
注意区分：record（n. 记录、唱片 /ˈrekɔːd/；v. 记录 /rɪˈkɔːd/，重音不同）/ recorded（已录制的、有记录的，形容词）/ keep a record of（记录…，介词 of）/ break a record（破纪录）。

sentences.text: Unsurprisingly, people's brains were most active when thinking about their current selves and least active when thinking about a current other.

analysis.translationLiteral: 不出所料，人们在想到当下的自己时大脑最活跃，想到当下的他人时最不活跃。
analysis.translationNatural: 结果毫不意外：想「现在的我」时大脑最兴奋，想「现在的别人」时最平静。

paragraphs.text: Put in practical terms, when thinking of yourself in a month or a year or a decade, your brain registers that person in ways similar to how it would register Taylor Swift or the mailman. Understood in that way, saving for retirement is the equivalent of giving money away to someone else entirely.

paragraphs.text: Seen through the lens of the present self versus the future self, our self-defeating actions—like choosing to watch television rather than go to the gym—suddenly make perfect sense. We get to enjoy the very concrete, immediate benefits of our actions while someone else (namely, our future selves) suffers the hypothetical (假设的), far-off consequences. paragraphs.text: "In one study, we asked people online about the goals they set at the beginning of the year. sentences.text: Other studies have shown a greater uptake of exercise in people who were told to think of the enjoyment of doing the exercise now rather than future health gains.

analysis.translationLiteral: 其他研究显示，在那些被告知去想「现在运动的乐趣」而不是「未来健康收益」的人当中，运动参与度更高。
analysis.translationNatural: 还有研究发现：让人想着「运动当下就挺爽」，比想着「以后身体会更好」更能促使他们动起来。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Other studies】 _have shown_ ~a greater uptake of exercise~ in people who were told to think of the enjoyment of doing the exercise now rather than future health gains.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 定语从句（who 引导）

components.note: uptake 此处意为「接受、参与」

clauses: who were told to think of... 是定语从句，修饰 people。
关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。
含转折/取舍副词，用来修正或替代前一句的说法。

phrases.meaning: 而不是
phrases.usage: 连接并列成分，前后形式要一致；后接动词时常用原形。
phrases.example: I'd walk rather than wait. 我宁愿走路也不等。

phrases.meaning: 研究（study 的复数）；study 的第三人称单数
phrases.usage: 注意区分：studies（复数/三单）/ study（单数）。常见搭配：studies show that / recent studies。
phrases.example: Studies suggest a strong link. 研究表明存在强关联。

phrases.meaning: 更大的（great 的比较级）；更重大的
phrases.usage: 注意区分：greater（更大，抽象/程度）/ bigger（更大，具体）。常见搭配：greater independence / greater than。
phrases.example: The web is replaced in reaction to greater independence. 因为更独立，网络被替换了。

pitfalls: rather than 连接的两个成分词性要平行。
定语从句中关系词已充当成分，从句里不要再重复该代词。
instead 是副词，不能直接连接两个名词；instead of 才是介词短语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 补充运动领域的旁证，强化「关注当下愉悦」的结论。

paragraphs.text: These findings suggest that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits. In other words, present self trumps (战胜) future self. Who says instant gratification has to be a bad thing? By all means, set ambitious long-term goals for your future self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.

sentences.text: These findings suggest that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这些发现表明，谈到实现目标时，享受过程本身比想要长期收益更重要。
analysis.translationNatural: 结论很清楚：想让目标落地，享受过程比惦记长远好处更管用。
analysis.structMarkup: 【These findings】 _suggest_ {that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（含时间状语从句与动名词主语）

components.part: that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits
components.note: 从句主语是动名词 enjoying the process itself

clauses: that 引导宾语从句；when it comes to... 在从句中作时间状语。
本句含比较结构（比较级 + than），than 后是被比较对象。
that 引导宾语从句，作前面动词的宾语，从句用陈述语序。

phrases.meaning: 说到、涉及
phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
phrases.example: When it comes to money, be careful. 说到钱要谨慎。

phrases.meaning: 研究结果、调查发现（finding 的复数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：findings（研究结果、发现，常用复数名词）/ find（找到，动词）/ finding（单项发现，可数）/ findings 与 conclusion（conclusion 是「结论」，findings 是「发现的事实」）/ research findings。
phrases.example: These findings suggest that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits. 结论很清楚：想让目标落地，享受过程比惦记长远好处更管用。

phrases.meaning: 建议、提议；表明、暗示、使人想到
phrases.usage: 注意区分：suggest doing（建议做，接动名词，不说 suggest to do）/ suggest that + (should) do（建议，从句虚拟，should 可省）/ suggest that + 陈述语气（暗示、表明）/ advise sb to do（句型不同）/ suggestion（建议；迹象）。
phrases.example: These findings suggest that when it comes to achieving your goals, enjoying the process itself is more important than wanting the long-term benefits. 结论很清楚：想让目标落地，享受过程比惦记长远好处更管用。

pitfalls: 本句是第 38 题「享受过程比追求长期收益更重要」的直接依据。
when it comes to 后接动名词，不接原形。
比较级 + than 引出比较对象；两者比较用比较级，三者以上用最高级。
宾语从句用陈述语序，不要把助动词提到主语前。

sentences.text: In other words, present self trumps (战胜) future self.

analysis.translationLiteral: 换句话说，当下的自己胜过未来的自己。
analysis.translationNatural: 说白了：眼下这个我，压过未来那个我。
analysis.structMarkup: (In other words), 【present self】 _trumps_ (战胜) ~future self~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾

components.note: trump 作动词，意为「胜过、压倒」

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾」。

phrases.meaning: 换句话说
phrases.usage: 换述连接语，后接对前句的重述。
phrases.example: In other words, the plan failed. 换句话说，计划失败了。

phrases.meaning: 现在的、目前的、出席的；目前、礼物（动词「呈现/提出/颁发」读 /prɪˈzent/）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：present（n. 礼物/现在 /ˈpreznt/；adj. 出席的、现在的；v. 呈现/提出 /prɪˈzent/）/ at present（目前）/ be present at（出席…，介词 at）/ gift（礼物近义）/ absent（反义）/ present sb with sth（授予）。
phrases.example: In other words, present self trumps (战胜) future self. 说白了：眼下这个我，压过未来那个我。

phrases.meaning: 未来 / 未来的
phrases.usage: 注意区分：in the future（将来）/ in future（英式：从今往后）。常见搭配：in the future / future food supply。
phrases.example: The future of food is uncertain. 食物的未来不确定。

pitfalls: in other words 后接完整句子，不是单词同义替换。
注意区分：in other words（换句话说）/ in a word（简言之）/ word（单词）。
注意区分：present（n. 礼物/现在 /ˈpreznt/；adj. 出席的、现在的；v. 呈现/提出 /prɪˈzent/）/ at present（目前）/ be present at（出席…，介词 at）/ gift（礼物近义）/ absent（反义）/ present sb with sth（授予）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用一句话浓缩全文的核心判断。

sentences.text: Who says instant gratification has to be a bad thing?

analysis.translationLiteral: 谁说即时满足就一定是件坏事呢？
analysis.translationNatural: 谁规定「马上就爽」一定是坏事？
analysis.structMarkup: 【Who】 _says_ {instant gratification has to be a bad thing}?
analysis.structureSummary: 特殊疑问句（主谓 + 宾语从句）

components.note: 后接省略 that 的宾语从句

components.part: instant gratification has to be a bad thing
components.note: has to 表示「必须、一定」

clauses: instant gratification has to be a bad thing 是省略 that 的宾语从句。
宾语从句「instant gratification has to be a bad thing」：has to 表示「必须、一定」
关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。

phrases.meaning: say 的第三人称单数（说）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：says /sez/ 发音不按规则；注意与 say 的过去式 said /sed/ 区分。常见搭配：she says that / as the report says。
phrases.example: He says the change is coming. 他说变化正在到来。

phrases.meaning: 立即的、即时的、速溶的；瞬间、片刻（instant gratification 即时满足）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：instant（立即的；速溶的，形容词；瞬间，名词）/ instantly（立即，副词）/ for an instant（一瞬间）/ immediate（强调无需等待，instant 强调瞬间发生）/ instance（例子，拼写易混）。
phrases.example: Who says instant gratification has to be a bad thing? 谁规定「马上就爽」一定是坏事？

phrases.meaning: 事情、东西（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：thing（事情/东西）/ stuff（东西，不可数）。常见搭配：the thing is / the same thing。
phrases.example: Could the same thing happen to crops? 同样的事会发生在作物上吗？

pitfalls: 定语从句中关系词已充当成分，从句里不要再重复该代词。
疑问句中的宾语从句仍用陈述语序，不能倒装。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用反问为「即时满足」正名，呼应 I 段第三条对策。

sentences.text: By all means, set ambitious long-term goals for your future self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.

analysis.translationLiteral: 务必为未来的自己设定宏大的长期目标，但到了真正日复一日执行时，也要确保当下的自己知道其中有什么是给她的好处。
analysis.translationNatural: 长期目标尽管往大里定，可真要每天坚持，得让「现在的我」也尝到甜头才行。
analysis.structMarkup: (By all means), _set_ ~ambitious long-term goals~ for your future self, but {when it comes to actually following through day-to-day}, _make sure_ your present self knows what's in it for her too.
analysis.structureSummary: 祈使句 + but 并列祈使句（含时间状语从句与宾语从句）

components.part: when it comes to actually following through day-to-day
components.note: when it comes to 后接动名词
后接省略 that 的宾语从句

clauses: what's in it for her 是宾语从句，作 knows 的宾语。
状语从句「when it comes to actually following through day-to-day」：when it comes to 后接动名词

phrases.meaning: 说到、涉及
phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
phrases.example: When it comes to money, be careful. 说到钱要谨慎。

phrases.meaning: mean 的第三人称单数；手段、方法（单复同形）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：by no means（绝不）/ by all means（当然可以）/ means（单复同形）。常见搭配：by means of / a means of。
phrases.example: She argues the data means little. 她认为这些数据意义不大。

phrases.meaning: 长期的、长远的（与 short-term 相对）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：long-term（长期的，作定语带连字符，如 long-term goals）/ in the long term（从长远看，副词短语，分写、term 用单数）/ short-term（短期的，反义）/ term 还可指「学期、条款」。
phrases.example: By all means, set ambitious long-term goals for your future self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too. 长期目标尽管往大里定，可真要每天坚持，得让「现在的我」也尝到甜头才行。

pitfalls: 两句都是祈使句，主语 you 被省略；but 连接两个并列建议。
when it comes to 后接动名词，不接原形。
analysis.paragraphRole: 收束全文：长期目标与即时回报并不矛盾，两者要同时照顾。

questions.stem: Our brains are genetically determined to satisfy immediate desires.
Taken in a practical way, saving for post-work years is like giving money away to others.
Research found that, as regards achievement of one's goals, it is important to focus more on enjoying the process than the long-term benefits.
Regarding our future selves as still being ourselves will help us make better long-term decisions.
Savings rates in America have dropped in recent decades even though people's life expectancy has increased.
Researchers found that enjoyment rather than importance enabled people to persist in their goals.
When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences.
People ate more of a healthy food when they focused on its good taste instead of its long-term benefits.
As was expected, when people thought of their present selves, their brains were observed to become more active.
Researchers found that participants who saw the images of their aged selves would save more for their later years than those who didn't.

above.sense: 在…上方、超过；在上面；上文提及的（above all 最重要的是）

She achieved her goal in two years. 她两年内实现了目标。

Seen through the lens of the present self versus the future self, our self-defeating actions—like choosing to watch television rather than go to the gym—suddenly make perfect sense. 用「现在的我 vs 未来的我」这套框架一看，那些明知不好还偏要做的事（比如赖着看电视不去锻炼），一下子就解释得通了。
